overview: Riftwake is a networked arena FPS for up to twelve direct-IP players. Conserved momentum, air steering and bunny hopping support fast routes across The Fracture, a three-level industrial arena with health, armor and jump-pad shortcuts. Six weapons emphasize distinct ranges and prediction patterns, without reloads or aim-down-sights slowdown.
rules: The authoritative server handles movement, weapon hits, projectiles, pickups, frag scores and respawns.
Use momentum and air steering to travel; holding jump chains bunny hops when you land.
Health and armor pickups reward route knowledge and timing.
There are no reloads, sprint key or aim-down-sights slowdown.
This prototype needs human opponents: bots and matchmaking are not included.
controls: WASD accelerates; hold Space to bunny hop; mouse looks and fires.
Tab secondary stats; Escape menu; F/F11 fullscreen.
story: The documented setting is The Fracture, a multi-level industrial duel arena. No narrative campaign or named character backstories are established.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
